title: Optimizer-dependent training dynamics converge to the same one-third optimal data scaling
abstract: arXiv:2609.37745v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural scaling, in which loss falls as a power law with training, is central to large language models, and one recent proposal is that a $1/3$ exponent emerges from learning peaked distributions. That account describes SGD, but models in practice are trained with adaptive optimizers. Here we separate two exponents the $1/3$ account does not distinguish: how fast the loss falls with training steps along a single run, and how fast the optimally tuned loss falls with dataset size $D$. We show that the first, a dynamic exponent, is optimizer-specific while the second, an optimal data exponent, converges to $1/3$ across optimizers. In an online teacher-student model we decompose the loss into norm growth (radial) and alignment toward the teacher direction (tangential), each decaying as a power law with dynamic exponents $\alpha_{r}$ and $\alpha_{t}$. translated_title: 依赖优化器的训练动力学收敛到相同的三分之一最优数据缩放规律
translated_abstract: 神经缩放律——即损失随训练按幂律下降——是大语言模型的核心，最近有一种观点提出，1/3 指数源于对峰值分布的学习。该解释针对的是 SGD（随机梯度下降），但实际中的模型通常使用自适应优化器进行训练。在这里，我们区分了 1/3 理论未能区分的两个指数：损失在单次训练运行中随训练步数下降的速度，以及经过最优调参后的损失随数据集规模 D 下降的速度。我们表明，第一个指数（动态指数）依赖于具体优化器，而第二个指数（最优数据指数）在不同优化器下均收敛到 1/3。在一个在线师生模型中，我们将损失分解为范数增长（径向）和向教师方向的对齐（切向），每一部分都以幂律衰减，对应的动态指数分别为 α_r 和 α_t。在 SGD 下，两者都接近 1/3，因此数据指数在不同学习率下也表现为 1/3。
tldr: 研究发现训练动力学中的动态指数依赖于优化器类型，但最优调参后损失随数据量的缩放指数在不同优化器下均收敛于 1/3。
en_tdlr: While the dynamic exponent of training loss decay is optimizer-specific, the optimally tuned loss scaling exponent with dataset size converges to 1/3 across different optimizers.
